But the same brief says this is an OPERATOR coin with real warning signs. Bundle share is 100%, top-3 share is 100%, and the top-5 buyers hold 99.95% of early buying. Roughly 2,009 SOL came in from 15 buyers in the first two minutes after graduation, and the sell-to-buy ratio in that window was 0.0007, meaning almost nobody sold. Recent demand is thin compared with that: 29 buyers in 15 minutes, against a launch dominated by a few wallets. Whether demand "will still be here" depends on whether those operator wallets keep holding, and the brief doesn't show that. The launch bot is also present.

My read: the case is weak. The recent flow is positive, but the coin's price action rests on a handful of concentrated wallets, and the 30-115 minute base rate for operator-style coins is roughly break-even before fees of 1.4-5.1%. I would not buy on this brief. Skipping costs nothing.
